description: This Python source file provides utility functions for handling HuggingFace model templates, including fetching tokenizer configurations and chat templates synchronously and asynchronously, as well as extracting token values from various formats.

methods.name: strftime_now
methods.description: Returns the current date/time formatted according to the provided format string.

methods.name: _get_tokenizer_config
methods.description: Fetches the tokenizer configuration JSON from HuggingFace synchronously.

methods.name: _aget_tokenizer_config
methods.description: Fetches the tokenizer configuration JSON from HuggingFace asynchronously.

methods.name: _get_chat_template_file
methods.description: Fetches a chat template (.jinja or .jinja2) synchronously from HuggingFace.

methods.name: _aget_chat_template_file
methods.description: Fetches a chat template (.jinja or .jinja2) asynchronously from HuggingFace.

methods.name: _extract_token_value
methods.description: Extracts a token string from various input formats (None, str, dict).
